description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcMock' for the 'IMediaKeysCapabilities' interface, used in testing media key capabilities within the Rialto client component. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported key systems, checking support for a specific key system, and obtaining the version of a key system.
